sign_convention: trajectory ordered by time_window_min DESCENDING (farthest-from-onset first); positive tau / Sen's slope == AUROC rises toward onset == clinical faithfulness
bootstrap_resample_unit: highest identifiable unit: patient (subject_id) for EPIC/VitalDB, surgical case (case_id) for MOVER/SIS
alarm_rule: case alerts iff score >= threshold at some minute in the window
prevalent_definition: score at or above threshold at the case's first eligible scored minute; 'window' takes that minute inside 0 < t_to_event <= 60, 'record' takes the first scored minute of the whole case
thresholds: validation-fixed, read from pre_submission_revision_2026, not reselected
warmup_definition: an incident crossing whose elapsed monitoring time at the crossing is at most warmup_min minutes; incident by the letter of the definition, but produced by the input window filling rather than by any patient change
